si_4.answer: Neuroanatomical heterogeneity and homogeneity in individuals at clinical high risk for psychosis

nm2_1.detail: Person-Based Similarity Index (PBSI) was used to assess the 'normativeness' of neuroanatomical profiles.
nm2_1.supporting_text: Personalised estimates of heterogeneity of SA, CT and SV brain profiles were indexed with the novel Person-Based Similarity Index (PBSI)... Second, using a normative modelling approach, to assess the ' normativeness ' of neuroanatomical profiles in individuals at CHR-P.

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Cortical surface area (SA), cortical thickness (CT), and subcortical volume (SV) were modeled.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: Personalised estimates of heterogeneity of SA, CT and SV brain profiles were indexed with the novel Person-Based Similarity Index (PBSI)... PBSI scores indicated significantly greater neuroanatomical divergence in global SA, CT and SV profiles

nm2_2_explanatory_variable.detail: Data were adjusted for scanner protocol and site using neuroComBat, controlling for age and sex.
nm2_2_explanatory_variable.supporting_text: Neuroimaging data were adjusted for scanner protocol and site using neuroComBat [50]... controlling for group (CHR-P/HC), age and sex.
